claims.value: per-run file names; SAX fractions 1-6; separate injections as technical replicates
claims.evidence: All 359 RAW files (files list) appear in summary.txt. 45 experiments have six SAX fraction files (name suffix _1.._6 / -1..-6; MaxQuant Fraction 1..6) plus one extra unfractionated run (MaxQuant puts it at Fraction 2); 25 experiments have only 1-3 unfractionated runs, matching the paper ("In 25 cases ... we performed in-solution trypsin digestion and/or did not fractionate the samples"). SDRF: SAX set = technical replicate 1, fractions 1-6 by file suffix; each unfractionated run = its own technical replicate (fraction 1), numbered after the SAX set in file-name order.

summary.txt: Multiplicity 2, Labels0 empty, Labels1 Arg10;Lys8 for all 359 deposited files (rule 14 verified). Methods: "proteins from each clinical sample were combined with equal protein amounts of the super-SILAC mix"; analyses use "ratios of the unlabeled samples towards the same heavy labeled super-SILAC mix" -> light = patient sample, heavy = reference.
Light = clinical FFPE sample; heavy = super-SILAC spike-in reference standard (Methods "to serve as a reference sample").
PRIDE organism Homo sapiens; human breast tumours and human cell lines.
Macro-dissected breast cancer FFPE blocks (Methods). UBERON:0000310 breast. Heavy rows: not applicable (cell-line mix).

limitations: Precursor mass tolerance: only the first-search tolerance (20 ppm) is documented; MaxQuant main-search tolerance (default 4.5 ppm) not deposited (no mqpar.xml; parameters.txt lacks it). 20 ppm used because convert-openms refuses not available.
Sex: only HA_BC25 (male) is stated at individual level; the other 69 patients are not available although the cohort is presumably female - not inferred (rule 18).
Age, ancestry, tumour grade/stage, histology and treatment are not published per patient (Table S1 gives only subtype and inclusion status) -> columns omitted / not available.
HER2 group (1 sample, HA_BC12) mapped to MONDO:0006244 "HER2 positive breast carcinoma" whose definition is the gene-expression HER2-enriched subset; the paper subtype is IHC-based.
The 9 samples with Table S1 Clinical Annotation "N/A" are annotated with the generic MONDO:0004989 breast carcinoma (tumour status inferred from the Results counts), not with a subtype.

Unfractionated extra runs of the 45 fractionated samples are encoded as technical replicate 2 of the same source; whether they came from the same digest as the SAX set is not stated. MaxQuant placed them at Fraction 2 of the SAX experiment; the SDRF uses the physical layout instead.
Multiple single-shot runs of the same unfractionated sample (e.g. HA_BC50 x3) are technical replicates; re-preparation vs re-injection is not documented.
HMEC donor sex/age unknown -> reference sex not available; HMEC is a primary cell, so material type "cell" rather than "cell line".
Dataset-I (PXD002619) and Dataset-II (PXD000815) raw files of the integrated 212-sample cohort are separate deposits and out of scope.
